g.text: Alignment pilot/screen: 46 distinct input hashes, 610 runs
Points: file-level medians; bars: observed minimum–maximum across runs, not confidence intervals. F1 deficits are not fractions of residues moved.
Files may share taxa. Repeated runs are nested observations; reproducibility is finite evidence.
